thread:
morgan: Quick sync — external assessor asked for a KMS access window + RBAC snapshot before starting the engagement. Can we lock down logistics today?
priya: Yep. What's the desired window length? assessor asked for 4-6h, but we usually do 8.
ingrid: audit/logging question: they want CloudTrail + app audit export for the window. We can presign a GCS link for the assessor, or give read-only to the evidence bucket. Preference?
james: I can create an ephemeral role with 6h TTL and scoped to read-only for the KMS proxy. That covers keys. For bucket access I prefer presigned links to avoid adding IAM principals.
morgan: OK — plan: ephemeral KMS role (6h) + presigned readroom bundle for logs. Priya, can you take RBAC snapshot and confirm which service accounts must be excluded?
priya: Will do. I'll run the snapshot script and upload to /evidence/assessments/<timestamp>. Sample command:```
./scripts/rbac-snapshot --output /tmp/rbac-175431
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-175431.json gs://evidence-exports/assessments/175431_rbac.json
```
priya: Note: exclude internal CI service accounts per policy (see docs/link).
morgan: Good. Security-bot — create a ticket and add checklist for presigned link rotation + audit export retention.
security-bot: Created SEC-3121: "Assessor access window + RBAC snapshot" and added checklist (presigned link, KMS ephemeral role, audit export, evidence packaging). Assigned to priya and james.
ops-oncall: Heads up — we'll need to rotate readroom creds immediately after the window. Also make sure the observability export includes raw request IDs.
ingrid: Also confirm that we capture KV cache hits/evictions traces for runtime — assessor wanted evidence of cache isolation during load. That might require a short runtime trace export (~10MB).
james: I'll add a runtime trace capture step to the pre-window runbook. My plan: 2-min sample at start + 2-min at end. Will store traces in the same presigned bundle.
priya: Timeline proposal: Friday 2026-02-20 16:00 UTC start, 6h window, finish 22:00 UTC. Retest slot candidate: Monday 2026-02-24 morning. Any conflicts?
morgan: Friday works for security and infra. Ops-oncall?
ops-oncall: Fine. I'll be on-call for that evening. Will coordinate rotations.
ingrid: Remediation/tracking: create a lightweight board column "Assessor findings in-flight" and link to SEC-3121 for triage. We should agree SLA on triage 24h.
morgan: Agreed — 24h triage. Priya, after snapshot, can you post the presigned link + ephemeral role ARN in this thread so assessor team gets everything? Use the evidence checklist format.
priya: Will do. Also adding a pre-window dry-run Wednesday 14:00 UTC to validate exports and presigned links.
james: I'll kick off role provisioning dry-run then.
morgan: Thanks. Small action list: 1) priya: RBAC snapshot + presigned bundle + dry-run 2) james: ephemeral KMS role + runtime trace step + dry-run 3) ingrid: confirm audit export fields + retention 4) ops-oncall: rotate creds post-window and stand by 5) security: ticket SEC-3121 for tracking.
priya: On it. :thumbsup:
morgan: Cool — keep updates here. If anything changes ping @ops-oncall and @security-bot.
security-bot: SEC-3121 updated: dry-run scheduled 2026-02-18 14:00 UTC. Reminder set 24h before.
